points.quote: Each doc is a Yjs `Doc` holding the BlockSuite block tree as Y.Maps and Y.Arrays.
The same path handles incoming updates from storage. Other users' changes are applied as `apply` jobs.
It is persisted as binary Yjs updates (`Uint8Array`) plus merged snapshots.
awareness (cursors and presence) uses a separate channel and is not persisted.
Browser: IndexedDB, in `impls/idb/schema.ts`. ... Desktop and mobile: per-workspace SQLite through a Rust native module
`sync/doc/peer.ts` syncs a local storage with a remote one using per-doc timestamp clocks.
per-workspace SQLite through a Rust native module (`packages/frontend/native/nbstore`, using sqlx and y_octo)
